app_meta_title: ZPL editor | Live label preview, compare & export
app_description: Edit and preview Zebra ZPL labels in your browser. Compare versions, understand commands, and export to PNG, PDF or ZPL. No account needed.
social_image_alt: ZPL editor. Write ZPL. See the label. Live preview, label comparison, and PNG, PDF or ZPL export.
render_rate_limited: Labelary's rate limit was reached. Try again in a moment.
empty_preview: Nothing to preview yet. Paste ZPL or base64 into the editor. Labels are rendered by labelary.com.
compare_add_panel_hint: Add a panel to compare two labels
settings_hint: The label to render on, whatever ^PW or ^LL say.
use_zpl_size: Render at the size from ^PW and ^LL
invalid_size: Enter a size between 0.25 and 30 inches
explain_hint: Show what each line does in plain words. Hover any command to see what its values mean.
download_hint: Press Enter to download, or type a new name first.
download_zip_hint: {count} labels download together as a zip.
